description:
What Cliff reads from an uploaded file. A model: its measures and Cliff's machining plan for the process
    ('cnc' or 'turn') and material (setups, cutting minutes, stock, and manufacturability findings with where and how
    to fix each). A print (PDF, no process needed): its facts (material, finish, tolerances, threads, notes), each
    with the words it came from.
name: analyze_file
